setup.title: Choose where Her runs
setup.sub: Her works on the machine you choose: its conversations, memory and files stay there, and it answers while that machine is on.
setup.thisMacDesc: Her goes offline while this Mac sleeps
setup.thisMacDesc_win: Her goes offline while this PC sleeps
setup.windows: Update Hermesh on this PC to run Her
setup.thisMacDesc_linux: Her goes offline while this computer sleeps
setup.needsUpdate: Hermesh on this computer is older. Update it there to run Her
setup.newServerDesc: Install Hermesh on it and pair it, as Add Machine does
setup.signer: Confirm in the signer to turn on Her on {{name}}.

grant.runs: Her runs on this computer and works whenever it is on.
grant.desc: Her can use all your computers: start coding agents in any project, read their tasks and answer them. This doesn't expire. Turn Her off to end it.

head.team: The team: what it is doing

chat.greeting: Hi, I'm {{name}}. I work on {{environment}}. Tell me what you need, several things at once if you like.
chat.unread: This conversation is kept on {{name}}. It shows once the machine is back.
chat.queued: Delivered once it finishes this reply

reply.gone: The message this replies to isn't here anymore
reply.needsUpdate: Hermesh is finishing an update. Reply works once it has restarted.

onboard.greeting: Hi, I'm {{name}}. I work on {{machine}}. Before we start, I need a model to think and answer with. Pick a way to connect one.
onboard.chatgptNote: Use your ChatGPT subscription; you sign in in your browser
onboard.planNote: A model plan you subscribe to, such as Bailian, Volcengine Ark or GLM
onboard.keyNote: A key from DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic and others
onboard.placeholder: I can reply once a model is connected
onboard.browser: I've opened ChatGPT's sign-in page in your browser. Come back here once you've signed in.
onboard.signInCancelled: Sign-in cancelled. You can try again, or pick another way.
onboard.signInFailed: I couldn't connect to ChatGPT this time. You can try again, or pick another way.
onboard.pasteKey: Paste your {{provider}} API key below. It's kept only in {{machine}}'s credential store: it won't show in our conversation, and it's never sent to the model.
onboard.keyRejected: {{provider}} didn't accept this key: {{message}}. Paste it again?
onboard.keyRejectedPlain: {{provider}} didn't accept this key. Paste it again?
onboard.keyFailed: I couldn't save the key on {{machine}}. Try again?
onboard.keyUnverified: Saved. I couldn't check the key with {{provider}} yet, so let's carry on.
onboard.planUnverified: Saved. A plan's key can only be checked on the first reply.
onboard.done: All set. I'll talk with you using {{model}}; you can change it in Assistant Settings. What can I do for you?

tencent-token-plan.name: Tencent Cloud Token Plan
tencent-token-plan.note: General and Hy share a key

card.reconnect: Her needs to sign in to {{name}} again
card.what: Once connected, Her can use its tools and sends them what they need. Only connect services you trust.
card.secretBoundary: Sent directly to {{machine}}'s credential store and never shown to the AI model. Only connect services you trust.
card.siteLoginWhat: Sent directly to {{machine}} and filled once into {{origin}} without auto-submitting or saving your password. Never shown to the AI model. Skip to sign in directly in your browser or password manager.
card.offlineNoQueue: {{name}} is offline. Secrets are not queued offline.
card.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in and authorize in your browser…
card.update: Update Hermesh to answer this request

files.search: Search names, or what Her said
files.emptyTitle: The files Her sends you are kept here
files.emptyBody: Reports, sheets, pictures: every file she sends in the conversation can be found here again.
files.noneBody: Try other words: names and what Her said with each file are both searched.
files.offline: {{name}} is offline. This is the list as last seen; files opened before are on this Mac, the rest wait for it.
files.offline_win: {{name}} is offline. This is the list as last seen; files opened before are on this PC, the rest wait for it.
files.offline_linux: {{name}} is offline. This is the list as last seen; files opened before are on this computer, the rest wait for it.
files.needsMachine: {{name}} is offline; this file opens once it is back
files.earlierConversation: This came from a cleared conversation
files.notInConversation: That message is no longer in the conversation
files.noPreview: This kind of file can't be previewed here; download it to open it.
files.note: Each file Her sends you is kept on {{machine}} as it was when sent.

sources.silent_one: {{count}} more routine hasn't sent a file, so it isn't listed.
sources.silent_other: {{count}} more routines haven't sent a file, so they aren't listed.

preview.tooLarge: This file is {{size}}, too large to show here
preview.locked: “{{name}}” is encrypted. Enter its password to open it.

composer.label: Message
composer.dropTitle: Drop to add to the chat

model.thinkingChanged: {{model}} has no “{{from}}” level; thinking is now “{{to}}”

sheet.tooLarge: The image is too large: 10 MB at most

access.title: Give “{{name}}” full access?
access.body: It acts on {{environment}} without asking you, and so do the agents and scheduled tasks it starts. Her reads web pages and messages from anyone, so turn this on only if you trust everything on that machine to it.

clear.title: Clear your chat with “{{name}}”?
clear.message: The chat history is cleared and the work it is doing stops. What it remembers, its files, scheduled tasks and settings stay.

memoryClear.title: Clear what “{{name}}” remembers?
memoryClear.message: Its memory moves to the trash, and it stops remembering at once. The chat stays.

memory.title: Memory
memory.note: This is what it reads. To change something, tell it.
memory.emptyBody: Your preferences, what you decide and where things are: it notes them itself. You can also say “Remember …”.

panel.permissionNote: {{desc}}. The agents and scheduled tasks Her starts run with it too, while you are away as well. Full access is confirmed with Touch ID.
panel.mutedNote: No notifications from it, on any device. Unread still shows in the list.
panel.permissionNote_win: {{desc}}. The agents and scheduled tasks Her starts run with it too, while you are away as well. Full access is confirmed with Windows Hello.
panel.permissionNote_linux: {{desc}}. The agents and scheduled tasks Her starts run with it too, while you are away as well. Full access is confirmed with your password.

approval.label: Waiting for your approval
approval.sessionDesc: Calls like this one won't ask again in this conversation
approval.sessionRule: Commands starting with “{{rule}}” won't ask again in this conversation
approval.siteAlwaysDesc: Browsing and acting on this site won't ask again; kept in this environment
approval.siteEveryDesc: Browsing and acting on any public site won't ask again (private network addresses still do); kept in this environment. Risk: a page with injected instructions could get Her to act on sites it is signed in to.
approval.grantScript: Allow Scripts on This Site for This Conversation
approval.grantScriptDesc: Scripts on {{site}} won't ask again in this conversation
approval.grantAppDesc: Won't ask again for this app in this conversation
approval.feedback: Tell Her why, or what to do instead (optional)
approval.rememberDesc: Also keep this permission in the environment's settings, so later conversations don't ask

fail.auth: {{provider}} isn't signed in on this environment

failure.auth: Not signed in to the provider

advice.auth: Sign in again or enter another key in the console, then retry.
advice.quota_exceeded: Top up the provider's account or switch models, then retry.
advice.rate_limited: The provider asks to slow down. Retry in a moment.
advice.overloaded: The provider is busy. Retry in a moment.
advice.server: The provider had a problem. Retry in a moment.
advice.network: The environment can't reach the provider. Retry in a moment.
advice.timeout: The provider took too long. Retry, or switch models.
advice.context_overflow: Compact the context, or clear the chat in the assistant's settings.
advice.content_filtered: Rephrase the request, or switch models.
advice.unknown: Retry, or look at the details.
advice.no_reply: The model ended its turn without sending you anything. Retry, or try another model.

manual.title: Ask Permissions
manual.desc: Asks before changing files or running commands

accept-edits.title: Accept Edits
accept-edits.desc: Changes files in its folder without asking; asks before commands

bypass-permissions.title: Full Access
bypass-permissions.desc: Runs everything without asking, except deny rules, ask rules and deleting critical paths

steps.thinkingHidden: The provider keeps this reasoning private

routines.title: Scheduled Tasks
routines.newDraft: Set up a scheduled task for me:
routines.note: Scheduled tasks run on {{name}}. They don't run while it is off or asleep, and catch up once, with the latest, when it is back.

empty.title: No scheduled tasks yet
empty.body: Just tell {{name}}, for example “give me a pre-market brief every morning at 8”.

routines.runNowNote: Run Now really does the task.

result.skippedWhy: The run before it was still going

chrome.title: Connect your Chrome?
chrome.body: This step needs your sign-ins, which are in your own Chrome, and its extension isn't connected. Connect it once, and Her picks up where she left off.

progress.title: Progress
progress.emptySub: Give Her something to do: each part she sends out shows up here.
progress.notRead: The work Her sent out shows here once {{name}} is connected.
progress.doneLine: Done; its last words went back to {{name}} as its report
progress.waitingBehind: Another approval is ahead of this one; it shows here when its turn comes.

hp.chatgptWaiting: Waiting for the sign-in in the browser…
hp.chatgptExpired: The sign-in expired; sign in again
hp.chatgptNote: Sign in with a ChatGPT account
hp.subscriptionNote: Uses the account’s subscription; API keys are billed separately.
hp.keysNote: Keys are kept on {{machine}}, where only Her reads them. New ones are added on the console’s Models page.
hp.removePlan: The key saved in this environment is removed; your plan with the provider is not cancelled.
hp.removeKey: Its key is deleted from the credential store on {{machine}}, and its models leave the menu.
hp.removeCustom: Its models leave the menu, and its saved key goes too.
hp.fromEnv: Set in her environment on {{machine}}; to remove it, delete {{env}}
hp.shownNote: Those turned on show in the model menu.
hp.consoleNote: The console is the window that manages {{machine}}: models, connectors, skills, web search, the browser and storage.

sent.name: Files Sent to You
sent.desc: A copy of each file an assistant sent you, as it was when sent; the same content is kept once

conversations.name: Conversations
conversations.desc: Every conversation, with its tools’ full output

trash.name: Deleted Conversations
trash.desc: Moved aside when deleted, and not removed on their own

memory.name: Memory
memory.desc: What each assistant remembers about you and your work

browser.name: Browser
browser.desc: The built-in browser’s sign-ins and downloads

cache.name: Cache
cache.desc: Model lists, connectors’ tools, icons and logs; fetched again when gone

hp.counted: Counted each time this page opens.
hp.onlyCopy: This folder is the only copy of Her’s assistants, conversations, memory and the files they make. The relay and your other devices don’t keep it, so include it in this computer’s backups. Erasing Her’s data deletes it.
hp.noSkills: No skills of your own yet
hp.noSkillsHint: Upload one as a .zip or .skill archive.
hp.broken_one: {{count}} skill didn’t load; the console’s Skills page says why.
hp.broken_other: {{count}} skills didn’t load; the console’s Skills page says why.
hp.uploadNote: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md, uploaded as a .zip or .skill archive on the console’s Skills page. Her copies it into ~/.her/skills on {{machine}}.
hp.deleteMessage: It moves to the Trash on {{machine}}, and new conversations no longer have it.
hp.deleted: Deleted {{name}}; it is in the Trash
hp.userOnly: Her uses it only when you name it.
hp.pathsOnly: This skill comes from a folder in skills.paths. It can only be turned off here.
hp.binary: This file isn’t text, so it can’t be shown here.

exa.keyed: Key added · $4 per 1,000, $10 free a month

tavily.desc: 1,000 free a month, needs a key

brave.desc: $5 free a month, needs a key

hp.searchMaster: Let the Model Search the Web
hp.searchNote: The model searches when it needs to. What it searches for is sent to the services below.
hp.noneLeft: Every service is off, so the model can’t search right now.
hp.searchOrder: From the top down, the first one that can be used goes first; if it fails, the next. Drag to change the order.
hp.badSite: Enter a site such as example.com or https://example.com.
hp.controlNote: Her opens web pages and acts in them. Which sites she may use without asking is below.
hp.defaultNote: When the agent doesn’t name a browser, new pages open here.
hp.defaultLocked: Connect your Chrome to choose it. Until then, new pages open in the built-in browser.

yoursNote.off: Let Her open sites that need your sign-ins in your own Chrome, on the {{computer}} Her runs on.
yoursNote.ready: The extension is connected, but Her doesn’t use it yet.
yoursNote.on: Her’s tabs go in a “Hermesh” tab group and work in the background. Closing the “debugging” bar at the top of Chrome takes a tab back.
yoursNote.lost: The extension is not connected. Check that Chrome is open on the {{computer}} Her runs on, and that Hermesh is on in its extensions page.
yoursNote.outdated: The extension and Hermesh on the {{computer}} Her runs on are not the same version; the older one needs an update.

hp.builtinWindow: Her opens pages in her own {{program}} on the {{computer}} she runs on, without your sign-ins, in a window there.
hp.builtinNoWindow: Her opens pages in her own {{program}} on the {{computer}} she runs on, without your sign-ins, with no window.
hp.noChrome: There is no Chrome on the {{computer}} Her runs on. Install Google Chrome there, and Her finds it.

allSitesDesc.ask: Each site asks the first time it’s used
allSitesDesc.navigate: Sites open without asking; acting on them asks first
allSitesDesc.act: Sites open and are acted on without asking

hp.noExceptions: No exceptions yet. “Always allow” in a conversation adds a site here.
hp.sitesNote: Both browsers share these. Addresses on a private network don’t follow All Sites: each asks the first time.
